metadata_schema.doc_type: identity | company | partnership | product | service | solution | technology | faq | techdoc
metadata_schema.category: section key within the source file (e.g. healthcare, safety_systems, training)
metadata_schema.title: chunk title
metadata_schema.entity: named product / partner / person / program, empty when not applicable
metadata_schema.part_index: 0-based index when a long chunk was split
metadata_schema.part_total: number of parts the original chunk was split into

files.chikku_kb.jsonl: all chunks, one JSON record per line (canonical)
files.chikku_kb.json: same records as a single JSON array
files.chikku_kb.csv: flat tabular export, metadata as columns

notes: Metadata values are scalars only (lists are pipe-joined) for Chroma compatibility.
Chunk ids are deterministic, so re-uploading upserts instead of duplicating.
Filter with audience='customer' for the support bot; internal docs stay out of customer answers.
